basic_details.job_title: Innovsource Services Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 4 OT Technician, ICU Technician and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: M/s. Innovsource Services Pvt. Ltd., an outsourcing agency supplying manpower on contract to Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, Punjab, will hold walk-in interviews on 2 December 2026 (Assistant Public Relation Officer) and 3 December 2026 (Radiation Technologist, OT Technician and ICU Technician). Reporting time is 09:30 A.M. to 11.00 A.M. at H.R.D Dept, Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital, Sangrur Punjab – 148001. There is one post each, four in all, with pay of Rs. 24,260 to Rs. 45,000 per month; this is a private contract job through the agency, not a direct government appointment.

Relaxation in the upper age limit is given to persons from reserved categories such as SC/ST/OBC as per the instructions of the Government of India. Age and experience may also be relaxed for candidates with higher qualifications and/or deserving candidates, at the discretion of the competent authority; the notice adds that norms can be relaxed for deserving candidates with relevant experience.

content_sections.heading: About Innovsource Services
content_sections.text: M/s. Innovsource Services Pvt. Ltd. describes itself as an outsourcing agency for the supply of manpower services to Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, Punjab, on contract. The hospital is described in the notice as a unit of TMC, a Grant-in-Aid institute under the Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India. The notice is signed by the Supervisor of Innovsource Pvt. Ltd.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: For the ICU Technician (Anaesthesia) post, preference will be given to candidates with adequate experience in dialysis. Age and experience are reckoned as on the date of the walk-in interview. Relaxation in the upper age limit is given to persons from reserved categories such as SC/ST/OBC as per the instructions of the Government of India. Age and experience may also be relaxed for candidates with higher qualifications and/or deserving candidates, at the discretion of the competent authority; the notice adds that norms can be relaxed for deserving candidates with relevant experience.

content_sections.heading: Innovsource Services Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists a job description for the Assistant Public Relation Officer (APRO) post only: The candidate should possess excellent writing skills and knowledge of research and scientific terminology. Should be proficient in oral and presentation skills in English, Hindi and Punjabi language. Should be well-versed with latest social media platforms in handling computer software, mobile applications such as YouTube, Twitter accounts, etc. Needs to coordinator with local community, general public, media agencies, politician etc. Co-ordinate regularly with local leading newspaper of Chandigarh & Punjab region. The candidate should have a complete knowledge of event management. He/she should be well versed with the usage of MS Office (Word, Excel and Power Point).

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Photocopies of the following documents are to be submitted at the time of the interview: Resume and 2 recent passport size photographs (mandatory). Date of birth proof: Birth Certificate/School leaving Certificate/10th passing certificate. Educational qualification: mark sheet and passing certificate for final examinations. Experience certificate: for past employment, a certificate indicating the date of joining and relieving; for current employment, the appointment letter and last pay slip. PAN Card and Aadhar Card copies. Candidates should also carry the original documents for verification.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: In case of more candidates, an MCQ test will be conducted and eligible candidates will be shortlisted for the interview accordingly. The agency reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates called for the written examination, interview or skill test to a reasonable limit on the basis of qualifications and experience. Mere fulfilling the prescribed qualifications does not entitle an applicant to be called for the written test, interview or skill test.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates will not be entertained at the venue before or after the scheduled date and time. The posts are for a tenure of one year from the date of joining. The posting will be at New Chandigarh or Sangrur as per institutional requirement. The number of posts may increase or decrease as per the requirement of the institute. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature. If a candidate is found ineligible, or has furnished incorrect, false or incomplete information or suppressed material facts, the candidature will be cancelled. If this is detected even after appointment, the services are liable to be terminated forthwith. For queries, contact [email protected] , [email protected] or 01672-223910 (EXTN: 3941).

faq.question: Q1. When is the Innovsource Services walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for Assistant Public Relation Officer (APRO) is on 2 December 2026 (Wednesday). For Radiation Technologist, OT Technician (Surgical Oncology) and ICU Technician (Anaesthesia) it is on 3 December 2026 (Thursday).

faq.question: Q2. What are the reporting time and venue?
faq.answer: Reporting time is 09:30 A.M. to 11.00 A.M. The venue is H.R.D Dept, Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital, Sangrur Punjab – 148001.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are 4 posts in total: one each for Assistant Public Relation Officer (APRO), Radiation Technologist, OT Technician (Surgical Oncology) and ICU Technician (Anaesthesia). The number of posts may increase or decrease as per the requirement of the institute.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the APRO post?
faq.answer: Graduate/Diploma/Post Graduate in Public Relation or Journalism or Mess Media or equivalent from a recognized university, with minimum 2 years' experience in the relevant field.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The limit is up to 30 years for APRO, OT Technician and ICU Technician, and up to 35 years for Radiation Technologist, reckoned as on the date of the walk-in interview. SC/ST/OBC candidates get upper age relaxation as per Government of India instructions.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for each post?
faq.answer: APRO gets Rs. 40,000 to Rs. 45,000 per month, Radiation Technologist Rs. 25,000, and OT Technician and ICU Technician Rs. 24,260 to Rs. 25,000 each.

faq.question: Q7. Which documents should I carry?
faq.answer: Carry photocopies of the resume, 2 recent passport size photographs, date of birth proof, mark sheets and passing certificates, experience certificates (or appointment letter and last pay slip for current employment), and PAN and Aadhar cards, along with the originals for verification.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: If more candidates attend, an MCQ test will be conducted and eligible candidates will be shortlisted for the interview accordingly. The agency may also restrict the number of candidates called for the test or interview based on qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No. The posts are on contract through Innovsource Services Pvt. Ltd., an outsourcing agency supplying manpower to Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, Punjab, for a tenure of one year from the date of joining.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the selected candidates be posted?
faq.answer: The posting will be at New Chandigarh or Sangrur as per institutional requirement.
